title: CADEX Race 25 Tubeless Tire
notes: Official US store read 2026-11-01: US$78, original price US$105; only 700x25C offered. 270 g; ETRTO 25x622; 85-125 psi (5.9-8.6 bar); 170 TPI single-layer Supple Race Casing; Kevlar/carbon composite folding bead; RR-S silica compound; Race Shield Kevlar puncture protection. A product-page answer says CADEX tires are compatible with Giant wheelsystems; no general hookless statement.
